title: PipelinePhase
description: The canonical phase-contract object (ADR-0006). A pipeline is ordered phases; each phase carries its id, the agent and model tier that run it, the gate set that must pass, its fan-out strategy (single|fleet), and the original goal it serves. Fleet is a phase strategy; a Workflow is a degenerate single-phase pipeline compiled to this same shape.

id.description: Stable phase identifier, unique within a pipeline.

agent.description: The agent/role that executes this phase.

tier.description: Model tier for this phase (resolved by harness_core/model_tiers.py, e.g. 'planning', 'implementation', 'review').

model.description: Optional explicit model id, overriding the tier when a concrete model is pinned.

gate.description: The gate set that must pass before this phase is allowed to proceed/hand off.

required.description: Names of gates (from the harness gate registry) that must be green. May be empty.

strategy.description: Fan-out strategy: a single agent, or a Fleet of worktree-isolated workers.

goal.description: The original goal this phase serves (carried through for goal-alignment checks).
